highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Since its founding in 1952, Cambridge Education Group (CEG) has established itself as a premier provider of academic, creative, and English language programmes. Specialising in university pathways, the group is dedicated to helping you bridge the gap between your current qualifications and your dream degree. CEG provides customised educational solutions and works with prestigious institutions across the UK, Europe, and the USA, ensuring you have the best possible start to your higher education journey.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: When you join a CEG programme, you become part of a truly global community. With students coming from over 110 different countries, you will experience a diverse and inclusive culture that prepares you for a global career. You will have access to the same facilities, clubs, and societies as university students, allowing you to immerse yourself in campus life immediately. Dedicated support teams are also on hand to offer pastoral care, ensuring you feel supported both academically and personally.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Finding the right place to live is essential for your success, and CEG offers several high-quality options. There are student residences (modern, purpose-built halls of residence located close to study centres, often featuring en-suite rooms and social spaces), homestay (a chance to live with a local family, perfect for improving your English and experiencing the local culture firsthand) and private apartments (for those seeking more independence, support is available to help you find reliable private rentals).
 

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

You’ll have full access to extensive library resources, including quiet study zones, computer labs, and a vast collection of digital and physical books. These facilities are designed to support your research and independent study needs throughout your pathway programme.

2. Sports

Staying healthy is a priority, and you can take advantage of modern sports facilities. These typically include fully equipped gyms, fitness studios, and outdoor courts for sports like football, basketball, and tennis.

3. Laboratories

For students pursuing science or engineering pathways, CEG ensures access to state-of-the-art laboratories. These spaces are equipped with the latest technology, allowing you to gain the practical, hands-on experience required for advanced degree studies.4.

4. Cafeteria

On-campus dining options provide a variety of healthy and affordable meals. From quick coffee shops for a study break to larger cafeterias serving international cuisines, there is plenty of choice to suit every palate.
